_comment: Per-rule triage overrides applied by tools/automation_report.py. The keyword heuristic labels a rule 'mechanically-automatable' from its wording; these overrides correct that with hands-on review. A rule is only mechanically-automatable if it is checkable against TODAY's IR. Rules needing a new authoring/IR field are 'needs-ir-extension' (a grammar RFC); rules another gate already covers are 'already-enforced'/'enforced-elsewhere'; inherently semantic ones are 'human-judgment'. Each carries a reason.

action.compose.order.reason: Sequential-vs-concurrent safety depends on runtime read/write sets; enforced by the execution engine/scheduler, not statically. Terminal: runtime-obligation.

action.compose.saga.reason: IR 1.1 provides actions[].compensation (forward/compensation half). Multi-step saga ordering + durable state remain unrepresented (ledger: ir-partial, RFC-5); not automatable end-to-end yet.

action.destructive.scope.reason: Exposing the evaluated target count/preview requires evaluating the selection at runtime ('when technically feasible'); enforced by the runtime dry-run/preview path, not the static model. Terminal class: runtime-obligation.

action.device.safety.reason: Interlocks, current device state, acknowledgment, timeout and fail-safe behavior are runtime/hardware facts; enforced by the device runtime / safety controller at command time, not statically from the model. Terminal class: runtime-obligation.

kcf.extension.point.reason: Requires an extension-point registry + compatibility/governance policy that does not exist as a model field; until a registry exists, extension-point compliance is a governance review decision (see docs/IR-ROADMAP.md). Terminal class: human-judgment.

stack.governance.audit.reason: An audit/evidence path is a platform capability: every security-sensitive action is journaled by the runtime/platform audit subsystem. The model cannot statically prove an evidence path exists at execution time. Terminal class: enforced-elsewhere.

stack.name.visibility.reason: Export/visibility is module-packaging, enforced by the stack tooling (validate_stack.py / lint_stack.py), not the semantic model IR. Terminal class: enforced-elsewhere.

stack.graph.cycle-policy.reason: Executable-graph acyclicity/termination is graph-authoring guidance; the executable-graph runtime/emitter rejects cycles at build/run time. Not a core-IR static check. Terminal class: advisory.

kcf.profile.prohibited.reason: The prohibited-construct/pattern check is already automated as kcf.profile.pattern-prohibited; this rule is subsumed by that enforcement. Terminal class: enforced-elsewhere (superseded).

action.destructive.explicit.reason: delete/bulk-delete/replace are in COMMANDS, so action.invoke.effect-context already requires effect==command (explicit classification).

action.idempotency.create.reason: effect==command already requires an idempotency classification via action.contract.incomplete.

action.invoke.authorization.reason: effect==command already requires authorization via stack.security.authorization; the caller's runtime authorization is an external fact, not IR-checkable.

action.set.bulk-upsert.reason: bulk-upsert is a SET_MUTATION, covered by action.set.selection-required + action.set.atomicity + action.set.concurrency.

action.set.synchronize.reason: synchronize is a SET_MUTATION, covered by the same set-mutation rules.

stack.ownership.boundary.reason: Grammar-stack ownership is enforced by tools/lint_stack.py + validate_stack.py + module-lock, not the per-model analyzer.

action.set.invariants.reason: Whether cross-record invariants hold at the declared atomicity boundary is a semantic property, not a structural check.

kcf.concept.provenance.reason: Derived-ness in KCF is expressed THROUGH provenance fields (extractionMethod/confidence); there is no clean IR signal for 'derived but unprovenanced'. Assertion-level provenance IS automated (knowledge.assertion.provenance).

kcf.relationship.classification.reason: Keeping classification and identity 'distinct' is a modeling-judgment property with no structural signature.

stack.import.acyclic.reason: Grammar-stack/module-system property enforced by tools/validate_stack.py + lint_stack.py + module-lock + check_compatibility.py, not the per-model analyzer.

stack.reference.resolved.reason: Reference resolution is already enforced per-collection (kcf.concept.reference, kcf.relationship.endpoint, kcf.*.reference/*.kind handlers).

stack.reference.no-dangling.reason: Reference resolution is already enforced per-collection (kcf.concept.reference, kcf.relationship.endpoint, kcf.*.reference/*.kind handlers).

stack.reference.direction.reason: Reference resolution is already enforced per-collection (kcf.concept.reference, kcf.relationship.endpoint, kcf.*.reference/*.kind handlers).

stack.type.enum-member.reason: Enforced by the enum-membership handlers (action.operation/scope/selection/cardinality/atomicity/concurrency.unknown, kcf.*.kind, kcf.event.kind, kcf.measure.kind, ...).

stack.name.kind-compatible.reason: Enforced by reference resolution + the kind handlers.

action.transform.time.reason: Instant/local-time + timezone/DST conversion correctness is a runtime time-library concern, not statically checkable. Terminal: runtime-obligation.

action.transform.version.reason: Transform/schema version compatibility + migrations is a CROSS-REVISION fact enforced by the delta/migration tooling (like kcf.concept.version). Terminal: enforced-elsewhere.

action.set.input-shape.reason: A bulk operation targets a single entity type, so its input schema uniformity is guaranteed by that entity's type (enforced by the schema/emitter); tagged-variant inputs would need a separate multi-type construct. Terminal: enforced-elsewhere.

action.event.commit-order.reason: Emit-only-on-commit is a runtime delivery guarantee; enforced by the transactional outbox in the emitted runtime (ASOS outbox), not by static model checking. Terminal class: runtime-obligation.

action.event.duplicate.reason: At-least-once duplication is a runtime delivery property; enforced by the consumer inbox / idempotency ledger in the emitted runtime. Terminal class: runtime-obligation.

action.event.payload.reason: Emitted event payload conformance (before/after semantics + classification/minimization at emit time) is a runtime fact, enforced by the outbox/emitter runtime — consistent with the other event.* rules (commit-order/duplicate). Terminal: runtime-obligation.

action.transaction.external.reason: Whether a target system can actually provide atomicity is a runtime/topology fact the model cannot know statically. The IR-checkable slice (claiming atomicity under an incompatible transactionBoundary) is enforced by action.transaction.required; genuine cross-system atomicity is a runtime obligation of the transaction/saga coordinator (outbox/compensation/reconciliation). Terminal class: runtime-obligation.

kcf.concept.trait.reason: Which traits are permitted for a given concept kind requires a per-kind trait-permission taxonomy that does not exist; until then it is a modeling-review judgment. Terminal: human-judgment.

kcf.concept.version.reason: Semantic-version compliance (breaking->major, additive->minor, clarify->patch) is a CROSS-REVISION fact: it compares a model against its prior version. It is enforced by the delta/migration tooling (kcf migrate / IR delta), not the single-model analyzer. Terminal class: enforced-elsewhere.

kcf.profile.relationship.reason: Judging that a profile's relationship restriction is 'at least as strict' as the base definition is a profile-authoring judgment; no comparable machine-checkable strictness ordering exists in the IR. Terminal class: human-judgment.

lineage.complete.reason: 'Every derived item SHOULD have a lineage path' is a SHOULD-level recommendation surfaced as guidance, not a hard static error. Terminal: advisory.

stack.graph.dead-end.reason: A nonterminal node with no outgoing path is a graph-authoring warning per graph kind (SHOULD); surfaced by the emitter/runtime, not the core-IR analyzer. Terminal class: advisory.

organization.accountability.distinct.reason: Inherently semantic modeling judgment with no structural signature in the IR.
